notation.global[n]: DATA_008548 slot n; do not apply the dialogue name table to these indices.
notation.local[n]: Per-instance storage. local[0] is own script handle and local[1] parent handle.
notation.static[n]: Shared storage attached to a script definition.
notation.exprNN(...): Unresolved expression opcode NN and parsed arguments.
notation.actions: Lists begin with byte offset, then command label and arguments. commandNN is unresolved opcode NN.
notation.if: Prefix condition followed by signed jump operand. Interpreter false branch changes its cursor by operand minus four after reading it.
notation.startMission: Spawn script_index, evaluate arguments, store returned handle in result target.
notation.state: Change to the indicated phase index, ending this action pass.
notation.function37: Command opcode 37, not interpreter FUNC_000037; semantic naming remains unresolved.

expression50.meaning: Generate unsigned 32-bit RNG value before evaluating denominator, then return unsigned remainder. Denominator zero traps; no range guard.
expression50.rng_update: oldA=A; A=(A+B) mod 2^32; B=rotate_left_32(oldA,16); return B

expression37_commodity_branch.meaning: For selector >=1000 and matching player object, read 16-bit cargo count at selector-1000; medicine selector 1008.

command56.meaning: Append UI entry; its four expression operands become action, global[1], global[2], global[3] when selected.

allocation_warning.meaning: Allocates local storage with malloc; explicitly initializes only local[0] and local[1]. Do not assume all other locals start at zero. Script 75 reads local[3] without an earlier assignment in its decoded phases.

expression32.meaning: Test article ID membership in journal published list. Does not require the player to read the article.

expression56.meaning: Read signed physical-object random seed at +0xA0. This is not a hash of its displayed name.

journal_commands.meaning: Command 14 queues journal/article/priority with flags and earliest day zero; 15 removes; 16 replaces matching ID. Priority is not a delay.

calendar.meaning: Unsigned day counter uses year-zero-leap four-year 1461-day calendar; epoch 0x121CF7 is 3250-01-01. Seconds use unsigned tick division by 0xC22E.

command43.meaning: AI ship spawn, generator type 2. Operands: target object index, value copied to object +0x11A, result destination. Result is object index or zero on allocation failure. Sets AI state 9, target byte +0xFE and raw placement parameter 0x00315000; hull distribution and physical units not yet fully traced.

command21.meaning: Damage target object, with negative damage converted to 0x7FFFFFFF. Damage events can intervene before shield/hull effects; negative value is a lethal-damage attempt, not independently verified guaranteed death.

expression34.meaning: Selector 1 reads Imperial military points DATA_008913; selector 2 reads Federal points DATA_008912; otherwise zero.

expression49.meaning: Read system allegiance derived from generator fields. Mission selector 2 denotes Federal; selected script comparisons retain raw selectors.

command53.routine: ffe.asm JUMP_000434-435 / FUNC_000305 or FUNC_000304 / FUNC_000306
command53.meaning: Allegiance selector 1 modifies Imperial, 2 Federal military points. Second operand passed through AL then sign-extended from byte in FUNC_000306; large script deltas can wrap negative. Third operand preserved as handler argument.

command37_roster.meaning: Create type-7 roster entry, returning ID or -1 when six-entry roster is full. No cabin reservation in creation path. Consumers retain unresolved function37 label.
